outcome_evidence: The oven door is closed at frame 0 in left_ego_image. The robot gradually repositions toward the upper door/handle region, visible in image and left_ego_image at frames 120, 180, and 260. At frames 300–317, the arm partly obscures the door in left_ego_image and wrist_image, but no outward door opening is visible in any view. Completion is therefore unconfirmed in the observed episode; the images do not clearly establish a completed failed acquisition or unsuccessful pull, rather than an unfinished approach/alignment attempt.
